# KarKo AI

> AI-powered job application assistant that generates complete, tailored job applications in under 90 seconds.

## What is KarKo AI?

KarKo AI is a web-based tool that helps job seekers apply to jobs faster and smarter. It uses agentic AI to analyze job descriptions, optimize CVs for ATS compatibility, generate tailored cover letters, and draft professional application emails — all from a single job posting paste.

## Key Features

- **Complete 4-Document Application Package**: Paste a job description and get an optimized CV, personalized cover letter, professional application email, AND follow-up email — all in under 90 seconds.
- **AI CV Optimization**: Tailors your CV to match each job description while preserving your authentic experience. Zero fabrication — every claim is traced back to your uploaded CV.
- **Smart Fit Analysis**: Scores your match against job requirements (0-100), identifies gaps, and provides honest assessments before you apply.
- **Anti-Hallucination Guardrails**: Unlike generic AI tools, Karko AI verifies every skill, metric, and experience against your source CV. No invented qualifications.
- **Personalized Cover Letters**: Creates human-sounding cover letters that reference specific company details and job requirements.
- **Application & Follow-Up Emails**: Professional emails ready to send — both the initial application and a follow-up email for after you apply.
- **6 ATS-Optimized CV Templates**: Choose from US and EU formats (including 2 German templates: German ATS two-column and German Classic single-column).
- **Application Tracker**: Track all your applications with status management (applied, interview, rejected, accepted, follow-up), match scores, and company details.
- **Master CV Support**: Upload a comprehensive Master CV once for better AI-powered tailoring across all applications.
- **Multi-Language Support**: Works with job descriptions in English, German, and other languages.
- **Two Workflow Modes**: "Analyze First" (fit assessment then generate) or "Apply Directly" (full generation in one pass).
- **ATS Compatibility**: Works seamlessly with Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, SAP SuccessFactors, iCIMS, Taleo, BambooHR, and SmartRecruiters.

## How It Works

1. Upload your CV (PDF or DOCX)
2. Paste a job description
3. Choose: Analyze First (fit assessment then generate) or Apply Directly (full generation)
4. Review and download your optimized CV, cover letter, and email

## Pricing

- **Free Plan**: 10 credits/month (~5 applications), no credit card required
- **Plus Plan**: $39.99/month — 100 credits (~50 applications), priority support
- **Max Plan**: $79.99/month — 200 credits (~100 applications), Chrome Extension (coming soon), premium support
- **Add-on Credit Pack**: $19.99 for 40 credits (available for all plans)

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript
- Powered exclusively by **Claude Sonnet 4.6 by Anthropic** — a frontier-grade AI model specialized for job applications
- Anti-hallucination guardrails: every skill, metric, and claim is verified against uploaded CV data
- Real-time streaming progress with agentic workflow (analyze first mode + apply directly mode)
- 6 ATS-optimized CV templates (US and EU markets, including German formats)
- Generates 4-document application package: optimized CV, cover letter, application email, follow-up email
- Application tracker with match scoring and status management
- Secure: CVs are processed in-memory, not stored permanently
- GDPR compliant

## Target Users

- Job seekers applying to multiple positions
- Career changers needing CV adaptation
- International job seekers (multi-language support)
- Anyone who wants to save time on job applications
